description: Delete a file or empty directory, without confirmation; a non-empty directory needs `recursive: true` and is deleted with everything under it. `pluginId` targets another plugin of the project instead of the installed one.

path.description: Path of the file or directory.

pluginId.description: Id of the plugin to act on (see plugins_list); the installed plugin if omitted (CLI: --plugin-id).

name: plugins_files_delete
title: Delete plugin file
